mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.kind, p.subject_id, COALESCE(c.display_name, p.subject_id), p.title, left(p.body, 120), p.updated_at FROM review_post p LEFT JOIN catalog_character c ON c.character_id = p.subject_id AND p.kind <> 'CONTENT' ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.post_id LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}
